## Speed Up Your Computer

BarraCuda SSD solutions come in both 2.5 SATA and M.2 2280 form factors, perfect for ultra-thin and ultra-small laptops, mini PCs, and desktop PCs that need next-level SSD speed for accelerated applications and multitasking.

## SATA 6Gb/s SSD Speeds

Seagate’s Barracuda SATA SSD is up to 20× faster than HDDs. (Based on internal tests of PCMark8 storage 2.0 bandwidth, 169.2MB/s BC SATA SSD vs 8.34MB/s HDD.)

## Proven Reliability

With the BarraCuda SATA SSD, get:

- Up to 280TB TBW
- 1.8M hours MTBF
- 3-year limited warranty
